overview: The commission discussed outreach strategies, website updates for disability resources, and resident accessibility concerns regarding Medford Housing Authority projects. The commission voted to invite representatives from the Medford Housing Authority and the Medford Senior Center to upcoming meetings.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the previous month.

items.title: Officer Nominations and Note-Taking
items.summary: The commission opened the floor for secretary nominations, which remained unfilled, with Tom Hamel offering to assist with meeting notes.

items.title: Senior Center Updates and Resource Sharing
items.summary: Members discussed promoting Medford Senior Center programs—including tax assistance, TRIP transportation, and home maintenance—on the commission's website and social media, and considered outreach channels like city and school newsletters.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Accessibility Feedback
items.summary: Voted unanimously to invite representatives from the Medford Housing Authority to a future meeting after a commissioner relayed concerns that disabled residents' accessibility input was not being adequately incorporated in housing developments.

items.title: Senior Center Collaboration
items.summary: Voted to establish a monthly tabling presence at the Medford Senior Center and to invite senior center leadership to an upcoming meeting.

items.title: Medford Public Library Collaboration
items.summary: Members agreed to add Medford Public Library disability programs and resources to their website list and explore cross-promotional newsletter updates.

items.title: 2024 Disability Resource Fair Planning
items.summary: The commission discussed timing and coordination for the 2024 Disability Resource Fair, evaluating potential dates around city events, park completions, and inclusive event naming.
